text: 下面进入小作文 08 · 询问与咨询信：考研报考意向与导师课题组要求咨询答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：表达对导师前沿学术成果的敬佩并阐明求学咨询目的。
Having read your illuminating academic papers with great admiration, I am writing to consult you regarding your graduate research projects.
学术咨询经典破题：Having read your illuminating papers with great admiration, I am writing to...
I am writing to consult you regarding your graduate research projects.
第二段：礼貌客气提出三个具有深度、体现求学诚意的专业问题。
In the first place, could you provide guidance on academic prerequisites? In the second place, are interdisciplinary students encouraged?
委婉提问句型：I would be exceedingly grateful if you could clarify... / I wonder whether...
I wonder whether students from interdisciplinary backgrounds are encouraged.
第三段：诚挚感激导师在百忙之中的点拨指导。
Thank you very much for your precious guidance, and I look forward to your valuable insights.
求学者谦逊敬意收束句：Thank you for your precious guidance and valuable insights.
Thank you very much for your precious guidance.
